whatIs.a: Kreavify is an AI Financial Intelligence platform for Indonesian creative freelancers. We help you make better financial decisions with revenue forecasts, market pricing analysis, and data-driven insights.

createAccount.q: How do I create an account?
createAccount.a: Click "Get started" at the top right, fill in your name, email, and password, then verify your email. It takes less than 2 minutes.

isFree.a: Yes! The basic experience is free. AI features are available for all users during hackathon/demo.

createInvoice.q: How do I create a new invoice?
createInvoice.a: Go to "Invoices" → click "+ New Invoice" → fill client and service items → click "Save" or "Send to Client".

clientNeedsAccount.q: Do clients need a Kreavify account to pay?
clientNeedsAccount.a: No. Clients can open the invoice link and pay without signing up.

sendReminder.q: How do I send automatic payment reminders?
sendReminder.a: Open an invoice with status "Pending", then click "Send WhatsApp Reminder".

invoiceNumber.q: What is the invoice number format?
invoiceNumber.a: Invoice numbers are generated automatically in the format KK-[YEAR]-[NUMBER]. Example: KK-2025-0001.

publicProfile.q: How can I share my public profile?
publicProfile.a: Your public profile is available at /p/[your-username]. You can share it from the "Public profile" menu.

addPortfolio.q: How do I add portfolio work?
addPortfolio.a: Go to "Portfolio" → click "+ Add work" → fill details → Save.

bannerNotSaved.q: Why isn't my banner photo saved?
bannerNotSaved.a: Make sure the file is under 5MB and JPG/PNG/WebP. Wait for upload to finish, then click "Save changes".

generateContract.q: How do I generate a contract automatically?
generateContract.a: From "Contracts" or invoice details, click "Generate Contract" to create a professional draft.

legalPower.q: Are my digital contracts legally valid?
legalPower.a: Contracts include standard clauses. For high-value projects, consult a legal professional.

revenueForecast.q: How does AI Revenue Forecasting work?
revenueForecast.a: AI analyzes your invoice history to forecast next month’s revenue, including a confidence score.

accuracy.a: Accuracy depends on how consistent your historical data is. Use predictions as guidance, not a guarantee.

pricing.q: How does AI Pricing Intelligence work?
pricing.a: AI analyzes market pricing by category, experience, and complexity to recommend a competitive price range.

dataSource.q: Where does market pricing data come from?
dataSource.a: From anonymized platform transactions and a default pricing matrix based on industry research.

mustFollow.q: Do I have to follow the AI recommendation?
mustFollow.a: No. It’s guidance—you always stay in control of your pricing.

taxEstimate.q: How does Kreavify estimate my tax?
taxEstimate.a: We estimate tax from your gross paid invoices based on common SME rules. This is an estimate—consult a professional for official calculations.

taxAccuracy.a: Tax reports are based on invoices marked as "Paid" only. Ensure statuses are up to date.
